rubric.role_summary: Senior product designer shaping AI-agent experiences and customer workflows for security and compliance teams, including human oversight of automated work.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior product designer shaping AI-agent experiences and customer workflows for security and compliance teams, including human oversight of automated work.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 7+ years of product design experience, with depth in B2B SaaS, complex workflows, or other sophisticated software products.
- Experience designing AI-powered products, automation, or systems with dynamic or uncertain behavior.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Ability to design agent experiences beyond chat, including systems involving agents, skills, tools, memory, and multi-step workflows.
- Experience designing products requiring human judgment, including when and how to involve a person in an automated workflow.
- Experience designing across surfaces a product team may not fully control, such as Slack, terminal environments, or other third-party interfaces.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): U.S.. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.

location.requirement_text: Location: U.S. (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

soft_requirements: Strong product thinking and discovery skills; ability to frame ambiguous problems and identify useful questions.
High craft in interaction design, information architecture, UX writing, and visual design.
Strong cross-functional collaboration and clear communication; ability to influence without formal authority.
Thoughtful approach to responsible AI and ability to move between systems-level and detailed interaction design.
Curiosity, sound judgment, and comfort in emerging product spaces.
Uses or is open to using AI to strengthen day-to-day work, with willingness to learn and responsible judgment.
